flags.why: Nước bạn means a friendly country, which need not be a neighbouring country.
flags.fix: The king and queen visited a friendly country.

flags.why: The physical sense denotes swelling or engorgement from accumulated bodily fluids, rather than general stiffness or rigidity ([dictionary](https://www.rung.vn/dict/vn_vn/C%C6%B0%C6%A1ng)).
flags.fix: swollen; engorged (with blood, pus or milk)

flags.why: A neck stiff from cold would be described as cứng, not cương cứng.
flags.fix: Hai bầu vú của chị ấy bị cương vì sữa về nhiều. = Her breasts became engorged because she was producing a lot of milk.

flags.why: The verb is formal, but uncommon alone does not warn the learner about its register ([dictionary](https://vdict.com/th%E1%BB%89nh%20c%E1%BA%A7u%2C3%2C0%2C0.html?lang=en)).

Everyday Vietnamese also uses cá tính adjectivally for someone with a strong individual personality or a distinctive style ([usage example](https://vnexpress.net/lam-sao-chinh-phuc-mot-co-gai-ca-tinh-3112834.html)).
flags.fix: adj | strong-minded; having a distinctive personality or style

flags.why: The example explains the word's meaning instead of using it to refer to grammar.
flags.fix: Ông học mẹo tiếng Pháp ở trường. = He studied French grammar at school.
